tools.name: template_read
tools.description: Read the template being edited. With no arguments: its version, and the template — whole, or as an outline of every node with the parts `about` names in full when it is too large to send — plus the space's own data models. With `ids`, those nodes in full; with `find`, the nodes whose type or text matches. Read the `template` documentation topic before a first edit.

find.description: Text or a type to look for, e.g. "Load more".

about.description: What the edit is about, in words — chooses which nodes of a large template come back in full.

tools.name: template_update
tools.description: Apply patches to the template and SAVE them, as one change everybody sees. Put every patch an edit needs in one call. Pass the version template_read gave: a template that has changed since is refused. `dry_run` checks the patches without saving. Each patch targets a node by its id, with exactly one of node, insert, remove or split.

targetId.description: For node (update): the id of the node to merge into. For insert/remove: the id of the PARENT node whose children/routes array to modify. Use "" for root.

node.description: Partial node to merge (JSON Merge Patch). Absent keys preserved, null deletes a key. Mutually exclusive with insert/remove.

after.description: ID of sibling to insert after. Omit to append.

before.description: ID of sibling to insert before.

node.description: The new route node to insert.

after.description: ID of sibling route to insert after. Omit to append.

before.description: ID of sibling route to insert before.

insert.description: Insert into children or routes array. Mutually exclusive with node/remove.

remove.description: Remove from children or routes array by child ID. Mutually exclusive with node/insert.

split.description: targetId is a $ref: give THIS use of the shared shape a copy of its own, so a later patch to it changes nowhere else. Every other use keeps sharing the definition. Use it when a request means one of several places that currently look alike; patch the definition itself when it means all of them. The copy is returned with fresh ids, so patch it on the next turn. Mutually exclusive with node/insert/remove.

dry_run.description: Check the patches and save nothing.
